text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp reaches its final 
stretch. Cheval Grand, who came to see 
Shine Praise off, bid farewell after 
firmly promising to grow stronger and race 
again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is stacked with top 
contenders. Umamusume with diverse 
strengths, such as stamina and racing 
instincts, step up to race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With capable contenders boasting 
unpredictable track records entering the 
race, it's bound to be a heated battle 
where nobody can let their guard down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, in her first race after the 
summer, the Kyoto Daishoten, a showdown 
awaited against Satono Diamond, who had 
debuted after her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just about finding her own 
strength—Cheval Grand felt the need to 
confront what she lacked and where she 
could still grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So, she reached out to Vivlos and Verxina— 
the very root of her complex— to ask for a 
joint training session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Toward the upcoming Kyoto Daishoten, and 
the promised Japan Cup— the fiery training 
continues.
